CHICAGO TITLE INSURANCE COMPANY
TITLE COMMITMENT FOR TITLE INSURANCE

Commitment Number: CTIC-AZ-2026-04219
Effective Date: April 1, 2026 at 7:30 AM

SCHEDULE A

1. Commitment Date: April 1, 2026
2. Policy (or Policies) to be issued:
   ALTA Owner's Policy (2021)
   Policy Amount: $85,000.00
   Proposed Insured: DESERT TRAIL PROPERTIES LLC
3. The estate or interest in the Land described or referred to in this Commitment is: Fee Simple
4. The Title is, at the Commitment Date, vested in: ROBERT M. JENKINS
5. The Land is described as follows:
   Lot 22, Block 7, Saguaro Estates Unit Two, Cochise County, Arizona

SCHEDULE B — PART II: EXCEPTIONS

The Policy will not insure against loss or damage resulting from the terms and conditions of any lease or easement identified in Schedule A, and the following matters:

1. Taxes for the year 2026, not yet due and payable.

2. CLAIM OF LIEN recorded November 12, 2024, in Book 1247 at Page 118, Official Records of Cochise County, in favor of SAGUARO ESTATES HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION, INC., for delinquent assessments in the principal amount of $8,421.00, plus accrued interest, late fees, and attorneys' fees. Said lien remains of record and has not been satisfied of record as of the Commitment Date.

3. Covenants, conditions and restrictions recorded August 3, 1998, as Document No. 1998-42118, Official Records of Cochise County, Arizona.

4. 10-foot public utility easement along the rear lot line as shown on the recorded plat.

THIS COMMITMENT SHALL TERMINATE IN SIX (6) MONTHS FROM THE COMMITMENT DATE UNLESS A POLICY IS ISSUED.
